comment: Fixed vectors for sidecar/protocol/bridge's VerifySigned and VerifyPresenceCountersign (§6.9, §7.9, §16.6; FS-124). All keys are synthetic. Bytes are lowercase hex. Each trees entry is over the leaves d_i = SHA-256(signed bytes of purpose authority, type 0x1206, body u32be(i)); an act's root is RFC 9162's MTH over its statements' digests in act order, so a leaf hash is SHA-256(0x00 || d_i).
